senses.gloss: €1P. (शणति) To give.

Hemp. 
-Comp. 
-तान्तव a. made of hempen string; वैश्यस्य शणतान्तवी (मेखला) [[Ms. 2. 42.]] 
-पट्टः hempen bandage. 
-सूत्रम् 
__1 a hempen cord or string; शणसूत्रमयं राज्ञः (उपवीतम्) [[Ms. 2. 44.]] 
__2 a net made of hemp. 
__3 cordage.
A bank or alluvial island in the middle of the river Śoṇa.
A bank or spot of ground in the Śoṇa river.
A eunuch (= शण्ढ q. v.).

[शण्ड् अच् [[Uṇ. 1. 113]]] 
__1 An impotent man, a eunuch. 
__2 A bull. 
__3 A bull at liberty to move. 
__4 Curds. 
-ण्डम् A collection, multitude; cf. षण्ड or खण्ड.

__1 A bull. 
__2 A bull set at liberty; a breeding bull; नीलषण्डप्रमोक्षेण अमावास्यां तिलोदकैः [[Mb. 13. 125. 73.]] 
__3 A eunuch; (14 or 20 classes of eunuchs are mentioned by different writers); कुब्जवामनषण्डकाः [[Kau. A. 1. 12.]] 
__4 A group, multitude; collection, heap, quantity (n. also in this sense); तस्मिन् स्व आश्रमे व्यासो बदरीषण्डमण्डिते [[Bhāg. 1. 7. 3]]; कलरवमुपगीते षट्पदौघेन [Page1583-1] धत्तः कुमुदकमलषण्डे तुल्यरूपामवस्थाम् [[Śi. 11. 15]]; cf. खण्ड also. 
-ण्डः, -ण्डम् A flock (of goats &c.).

€1P. (शण्डति) 
__1 To heap, collect. 
__2 To hurt, wound.
[शण्ड्-इलच् [[Uṇ. 1. 53]]] A sage.

__1 A eunuch, an impotent man. 
__2 A male attendant in the women's apartments (chosen from the class of eunuchs or emasculated persons). 
__3 A bull. 
__4 A bull at liberty to move. 5 A mad-man.

षण्ढः,
षण्ढकः A eunuch; [[Y. 1. 215.]] 
__2 The neuter gender; निवेशः शिबिरं षण्ढे [[Ak.]]; ‘षण्ढो वर्षवरे क्लीबे गोपतौ वन्ध्यपूरुषे’ इति विश्वः; प्रतिज्ञां षण्ढकोऽस्मीति करिष्यामि महीपते [[Mb. 4. 2. 25]] (com. षण्ढो गोपतिः । पक्षे क्लीबः । ). 
-Comp. 
-तिलः 
__1 barren sesamum. 
__2 (fig.) a useless person.

a. 
(-णी f.) [शणेन निर्वृत्तम् अण्] Hempen, flaxen. 
-णः 
__1 A touch-stone; मणिः शाणोल्लीढः [[Bh. 2. 44]]; [[Bv. 1. 73.]] 
__2 A whetstone. 
__3 A saw. 
__4 A weight of four Māṣas; अष्टौ शाणाः शतमानं वहन्ति [[Mb. 3. 134. 15.]] 
-णम् 
__1 Sack-cloth, coarse cloth. 
__2 A hempen garment; सर्वं च तान्तवं रक्तं शाणक्षौमाबिकानि च [[Ms. 10. 87]]; 2. 41. 
-Comp. 
-आजीवः an armourer.
A plant from the fibres of which a coarse cloth is prepared.
The smell of the breath of a cow.
p. p. Whetted, ground, sharpened (on a whetstone).

__1 A touchstone. 
__2 A white stone. 
__3 A saw. 
__4 A hempen garment; वस्त्राणां प्रवरा शाणी [[Mb. 3. 190. 19.]] 
__5 A ragged garment; शाणीवालपरीधानो व्याघ्रचर्मपरिच्छदः [[Mb. 12. 303. 13.]] 
__6 A small screen or tent. 
__7 Gesticulation, a sign made with the hands or eyes. 
__8 A weight of four Māṣas.

__1 N. of a sage, the author of a law-book. 
__2 The Bilva tree. 
__3 A form of Agni. 
-Comp. 
-गोत्रम् the family of Śāṇḍilya.
A eunuch.

__1 A pond, pool. 
__2 A wanton or unchaste woman. 3 A weight or measure of oil (1̭16th of a seer).
[षड् मातरोऽस्य] Having six mothers, an epithet of Kārtikeya.

a. 
(-की f.) 
__1 Six monthly, half-yearly. 
__2 Six months old; मौक्तिकानां षाण्मासिकानाम् [[Vb. 1. 17.]]
A hempen cord or thread.
See षण्ढ.
a. Uncastrated.
A pair of tongs or nippers.
A female camel.
